userConfirmed: 2026-10-22 user-confirmed refinement: restore the engineer header wireframe-to-solid drawing cycle used by Hero. Slow the silver-to-silver transfer and first exchange approach; allow natural film-length growth. Roll both 80 mm end-effector wheels from signed real ground travel with correct axis/direction. Keep continuous stair traverse between necessary support events, start with a 32.5 mm farther rear contact, and remove the final separate 0.30 m dragging move. After all four main wheels are on the upper platform, unload and recover seven axes with overlapping timing, avoiding stored ores. Ordinary driving starts only after the actual VT03 optical axis is aligned and keeps it horizontal along velocity; loaded stair work and station-side work micro-adjustments are explicit exceptions. Raise emission to 30 Hz and continue pursuit until the rough-road entrance, then stop new shots while existing projectiles finish. Retrieve the stored silver ore from above before the second exchange and approach the station 30 mm closer within checked clearance. Latest follow-up supersedes the corresponding posture/timing/camera-exception details: Follow-up confirmed on 2026-10-22: lower only the opening empty-cup travel and point its suction face along vehicle forward. After storing both silver ores, use the safe forward-facing27deg shoulder pose and translate the chassis on the endpoint-to-endpoint straight line, with J0/J1 and gimbal fixed; this short strafe is an explicit exception to velocity-facing video transmission. Begin stair preparation only after stopping. Reduce the accepted post-stair overlapping seven-axis recovery from6 to4.5 physical seconds including ready wait, preserving its support/unload path and gold-travel terminal pose. Before the second exchange swing J1(q[1]) rearward to about-156deg using the ordinary negative elbow, descend onto the ore from above, lift40mm with0..5deg local-X tool tilt, clear the other ore, then return J1 before approaching the second slot. No B-chapter change.
story: One continuous silent mission. Start with a lower, vehicle-forward empty cup. Take both silver ores from above and store them at the rear. Withdraw to the safe27deg shoulder pose, hold J0/J1 and gimbal fixed, and translate straight to the stair staging point. Stop before preparing the original reverse-elbow support. Roll the end wheels along the lower ground until all four main tyres reach the upper plateau. Stop at step-localZ1.300, unload, and recover the seven axes with overlapping timing and ore-clearance lift within4.5seconds including ready wait. Align the real VT03 before gold-island driving; the removed0.30m tail move belongs to that normal travel. Take gold through the side opening, lift45mm and withdraw. Carry low with VT03 horizontal along actual velocity. Emit30shots/s with predictive ballistic aim and CAD ricochets through chassis spin until the rough-road entrance. Park before each station target, slow the first approach and move30mm closer for insertion. Withdraw before recovery. Turn J1 to about-156deg with the ordinary negative elbow, retrieve the stored silver vertically from above, lift40mm while tilting0..5deg, clear the bank and return J1 before the second exchange. Tip both exchanged ores into the rear collector under gravity. Retain the other silver and finish camera-forward.

field.style: One persistent official-CAD field frame W=(-source Z,source Y,source X)/1000. Existing uncut terrain and existing detailed resource/station GLBs; dark fills and complete amber construction edges. Station housing fills are translucent to explain rear collection, retaining all original edges.
field.steps: A-specific original-CAD two-riser sequence. Prepare only after parking: cloud yaw, arm-base yaw, then elbow unfolding; retain the original reverse-elbow branch q3=-265deg (physical+95deg). Initial rear contact is0.68m behind the base,32.5mm farther than before. Loaded80mm-diameter end wheels remain on original lower groundY.003 with wheel centresY.043 until all four main tyres pass the second ledge. Traverse intermediate positions with one continuous speed curve per required support phase. Finish at step-localZ1.300 and remove the old extra0.30m post-unload dragging move. Unload, then overlap all seven recovery axes within4.5physical seconds including0.2727seconds ready wait; a smooth shoulder clearance arc avoids both stored silver ores. The actual camera is aligned before normal travel begins. Distinct from B single-step teaching; timings, loads and contact response are illustrative.
field.goldRetrieval: Approach the middle channel from the blue (-Z) side. Contact the vertical ore face, lift the ore 45 mm inside the glass-covered channel, withdraw horizontally, then retract outside the opening. Reference geometry checks cover the real ore hull and field triangles.
field.station: Original complete exchange-station.glb copied to official blue-side position with blue team strips. True base yaw, shoulder/forearm parallelograms, terminal yaw, roll and pitch. Receiving normals point slightly beyond sideways. Release and clear the manipulator before station recovery. The station carries each ore above a rear-side collector, then tips; ore follows gravity after clearing the slot, never slides through the back of a stationary slot.
field.stationRules: Rule pp87–89,91–93: level-4 receiving targets x[-270,0],y[-255,255],z[720,900]mm, x^2+y^2+(z-600)^2<=90000; theta[-135,135],phi(0,90],alpha[-45,45]; complete slot remains behind front-board plane. Two ores at distinct target poses; station moving time excluded. Check A/B targets and actual full-mesh clearance separately from recovery motion.
field.map: Rule page37 native figure, operator-POV orientation. Crop(231,227,795,438), physical28x15m interior(241.5,238,773,414); robot marker and route derive from the same actual W position as the 3D vehicle, with blue station upper right. Dynamic short fading wake, flowing look-ahead guidance, pulsing destination, live direction cone and action label; no permanent full-mission polyline.
field.route: Leave the highland through the open northern wide 10.666-degree CAD slope to the .203m road shelf (manual nominal10.5 degrees). Follow the shelf east, then the open10-degree blue-side ramp back to the main floor. Circle back to the blue exchange station. Do not use the 550mm-wide,450mm-high side tunnel or pass through its frame. Chassis spin settles before the return slope.
field.stationAxes: Terminal yaw from CAD815 57 mm circular flange [0,*,-.3293916606] along Y, output nodes841/842/971. Shoulder805 and811 endpoints both760 mm, second parallel pair810/812; actual roll and pitch retained. Empty CAD980 origin is not a pivot.

returnBake.method: Arc-length travel <=2.4m/s, acceleration2.3m/s2, braking5.5m/s2, corner lateral limit1.8m/s2. Four-wheel 11.2mm source-position rib contact, filtered road heave/pitch/roll and separate load transfer at120Hz.

Around the tight return corner, locally smooth actual positions before shared C1 interpolation; derive the optical-axis heading from the same analytic path velocity, including stationary lead-in fallback. Position and camera are not filtered independently.

Before the second exchange J1(q[1]) moves rearward to about-156.46deg while q[3] remains on the normal negative-elbow branch. Approach80mm above the true ore top and descend vertically at story67.5..68.8; attach at69.1, lift40mm at69.2..70 while local-X tilt increases0..5deg, clear the other ore and return J1 at70.35..71. Actual grip and stored orientations are in grasps.json; full ore/slot/robot CAD checks are separate from this authored motion.
field.goldGrasp: Middle gold ore begins at GOLD_PROP rotation Ry(-135), matching the original assembly. Side suction uses identity grasp offset; barcode-Y points toward slot-Y at placement.

suspension.method: Small illustrative sprung-body load transfer:4Hz, damping0.68, pitch/roll response0.0045rad per m/s2, heave0.55mm per m/s2, separated from the terrain-following wheel frame. Chassis remains level on the stair sequence.
suspension.evidenceBoundary: Not a measured spring/damper model or a calibrated full rigid-body simulation.
suspension.road: Four independently sampled wheel elevations;17-point circular tyre envelope.6Hz damping0.58 illustrative sprung response to actual ribs, separate from acceleration/braking compression. Chassis remains level on stairs.

energy.rotation: Both five-arm sides share one physical axis at pi/3rad/s, per small-energy rulep105. Pillars and suspension remain fixed. Single active fan per team is an illustrative background state.

markings.style: Original CAD floor silk-screen/gain-zone paint triangles, non-emissive pale grey; no glow or lamp substitution.

bumps.source: Original CAD arrow footprints; straight rib bands traced from the rule figure and clipped to the original highland plateau. Four-wheel circular contact envelopes use the same rib height profile as the visible geometry.

transmitter.policy: Original CAD tessellation/materials; two whole rear lead feature groups hidden by default. Housing, fins, lens, mounting ears and short housing-side ports unchanged. No proxy or decimation.

stationInitial.condition: Robot has parked before first motion; full native station meshes checked throughout the transition.

boundary: Combined mission and projectile attack are an authored functional scenario. Stair stage order comes from sequential real-robot demonstration frames; exact joints, lift stroke, loads, chassis speed and dump trajectory are illustrative, not calibrated dynamics or one match replay. Rule geometry and receiving constraints are verified independently. Source CAD stays read only.
camera: Continuous follow filming prioritizes robot, contacts and hand-offs. The follow camera retains terrain heave/pitch/roll. Actual VT03 optical axis comes from the original lens independently of suction normal. Ordinary moving30fps frames align it horizontally along actual velocity and pre-align before departure. Explicit exceptions: loaded stair support, the user-confirmed fixed-upper endpoint-to-endpoint stored-silver strafe(story23..26), and station-side short working adjustments. During that strafe J0/J1 and gimbal hold vehicle-forward while the chassis translates; stair preparation starts after stopping. The minimap uses the same physical clock.

projectiles.aim: Recompute a ballistic leading aim for every shot; no in-flight homing.
projectiles.contacts: Actual CAD triangle surface points/normals, including moving-surface velocity. Normal restitution0.46, tangential retention0.75. Impact rings and short traces visualize contact.
projectiles.evidenceBoundary: Authored illustrative parameters, not measured material coefficients or a replay of a specific firefight.
projectiles.endPolicy: Stop spawning at the rough-road entrance; already emitted shots finish their ballistic flight and CAD contacts.

First station target begins only after the robot parks; clear the arm before station recovery and gravity drop to the rear bin. Hide the two long rear VT03 leads, preserving housing, lens and mounting structure. Remove TCP trace and meaningless wrist-roll half-turns.
